header.title: Ensemble AI
header.tagline: The smartest AI is an ensemble.

tooltips.config: Configure your API keys and select operating mode

free.title: Free Mode

pro.title: Pro Mode
pro.description: Buy credits to get access to the latest models across all providers.

invalid_key.title: API key rejected
invalid_key.description: The provider did not accept your API key. Check the key on the configuration page, then retry.

missing_key.title: No API key
missing_key.description: No API key is set for this provider, so no request was sent. Add one on the configuration page, then retry.

rate_limited.title: Rate limit reached
rate_limited.description: The provider is limiting requests on your key. Wait a moment, then retry.

rate_limited.descriptionWithDelay_other: The provider is limiting requests on your key. Try again in {{count}} seconds.

timeout.title: No answer in time
timeout.description: The model did not finish before the time limit. The provider may be slow or stuck.

provider_unavailable.title: Provider unavailable
provider_unavailable.description: The provider is down or could not be reached. Retry in a few minutes.

interrupted.title: Answer interrupted
interrupted.description: The page was reloaded while this answer was streaming, so it is incomplete.

other.description: The provider returned an error. The details are below.

ensembleConfigurationSummary.heading: Your Ensemble Configuration

consensusPreset.heading: Consensus Preset

standard.title: Standard Summarisation
standard.description: Synthesise all selected model responses equally.

elo.title: ELO Ranked Summarisation
elo.description: Pairwise ranking with Top N synthesis. Needs 3+ models.

majority.title: Majority Voting
majority.description: Counts votes when the answers are short (a number, letter or yes/no), otherwise favors the majority position. Works with 2+ models.

council.title: Council Debate
council.description: Multi-round debate between models with critique and rebuttal. Needs 3+ models.

consensusPreset.minModelsWarning: ELO and Council require at least 3 models selected ({{count}} selected)

prompt.title: Enter Your Prompt
prompt.description: Your prompt will be sent to all selected models in your ensemble
prompt.tipsDescription: Small adjustments often lead to noticeably more aligned outputs.
prompt.tip1: Be specific and clear about the desired outcome.
prompt.tip2: Provide context, examples, or constraints when they matter.
prompt.tip3: Experiment with tone: analytical, conversational, or creative.
prompt.tip4: Iterate on length and structure to probe different behaviours.
